{{RV|type=command

|game1= argo
|version1= 1.00

|serverExec= server

|gr1= Argo

|descr= Sends a server request to the {{Name|bi|short}} cloud service and executes callback code with server's response.

|mp= {{Feature|informative|Only works on dedicated servers and {{Link|Arma 3: Headless Client|headless clients}}; for clients, use [[sendCloudRequestClient]]).}}

|s1= [[sendCloudRequestServer]] [requestName, callback, data, httpMethod]

|p1= requestName: [[String]] - can be anything but "users"

|p2= callback: [[String]] - (Optional, default "") code to be executed on request completion

|p3= data: [[Anything]] - (Optional, default "") JSON data to be sent

|p4= httpMethod: [[String]] - (Optional, default "GET", or "POST" if ''data'' is provided - case-insensitive) can be one of:
* "POST"
* "GET"
* "DELETE"
* "PUT"

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] on success, [[false]] otherwise

|x1= <sqf>_result = sendCloudRequestServer ["users/current", "hint 'success'", player];</sqf>

|seealso= [[sendCloudRequestClient]] [[sendAnalyticEvent]]
}}
